dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: High-degree concave curvature on the trailing edge, forming a smooth falcate spline from the apex to the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Moderate radius rounded apex; categorized as a rounded morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear incline of approximately 50 degrees relative to the visible horizontal base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white depigmented lesion located on the posterior-dorsal margin near the apex; multiple smaller white punctate markings distributed across the lateral fin surface.
